tickets.subject: Unable to log in after password reset
tickets.description: Customer reset their password via the email link but the new password is rejected as incorrect on the login page.
tickets.resolution_notes: Password reset tokens were case-sensitive but the reset confirmation email displayed the temporary password in all caps due to email client styling. Advised customer to copy-paste rather than retype, and flagged the email template for a fix.

tickets.subject: SSO login redirects to blank page
tickets.description: Customer using Okta SSO is redirected back to the app after authenticating, but the page is completely blank with no error.
tickets.resolution_notes: SAML assertion was missing the expected 'email' attribute mapping in the customer's Okta app configuration. Walked customer through remapping the attribute in Okta admin console.

tickets.subject: 2FA code not being received via SMS
tickets.description: Customer enabled two-factor authentication but says the SMS verification code never arrives on their phone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Customer's carrier was blocking messages from our SMS provider's short code. Switched their account to app-based authenticator (TOTP) as a workaround.

tickets.subject: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
tickets.description: Customer is locked out after entering the wrong password a few times and wants to know how to unlock their account.
tickets.resolution_notes: Explained the 30-minute automatic lockout window and manually unlocked the account after verifying identity. Recommended enabling password manager to avoid repeat lockouts.

tickets.subject: Login session expires too quickly
tickets.description: Customer reports being logged out every 15 minutes even while actively using the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Customer's org-level session timeout setting had been set to 15 minutes by a previous admin. Updated the setting to 4 hours per customer's request.

tickets.subject: Salesforce data not syncing into dashboard
tickets.description: Customer's Salesforce opportunity data hasn't updated in the revenue dashboard for the past 3 days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's Salesforce API token had expired after a security policy change on their side. Had them regenerate the token and re-authorize the integration.

tickets.subject: Sync job stuck at 'in progress' for 2 days
tickets.description: The nightly data sync job for a customer's integration has shown 'in progress' status for over 48 hours with no completion.
tickets.resolution_notes: A malformed record in the source data caused the sync worker to silently hang rather than fail. Added row-level error handling and manually restarted the job.

tickets.subject: Duplicate records appearing after re-sync
tickets.description: After manually triggering a re-sync, the customer now sees duplicate entries for the same accounts in their dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The manual re-sync didn't check for existing records before inserting. Ran a deduplication script scoped to the customer's account and added an upsert-by-external-id check going forward.

tickets.subject: Missing recent transactions after nightly sync
tickets.description: Customer notices the last 2 days of transactions are missing from their dashboard even though the sync ran successfully.
tickets.resolution_notes: The sync window was calculated using UTC while the customer's source system exports in local time, causing a boundary gap. Adjusted the sync window to overlap by 6 hours as a buffer.

tickets.subject: Integration with HubSpot throwing authentication error
tickets.description: Customer's HubSpot integration started failing with an authentication error after working fine for months.
tickets.resolution_notes: HubSpot had rotated their OAuth scopes and the customer's connected app needed re-authorization with the updated scopes. Walked them through reconnecting the integration.

tickets.subject: Revenue chart shows blank instead of bars
tickets.description: The main revenue chart on the dashboard renders as an empty white box with no bars or axis labels.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recent filter combination produced a zero-row result set, and the chart component didn't handle the empty-data case gracefully. Added an explicit 'no data for this range' state.

tickets.subject: Dashboard widgets overlap on smaller screens
tickets.description: On a laptop with a smaller resolution, several dashboard widgets visually overlap and are unreadable.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard grid layout used fixed pixel widths instead of responsive breakpoints. Filed as a known limitation and recommended a minimum 1440px display width in the interim.

tickets.subject: Pie chart percentages don't add up to 100%
tickets.description: Customer noticed the segments of a category breakdown pie chart sum to 97% instead of 100%.
tickets.resolution_notes: Rounding was applied per-segment before summing rather than distributing the rounding remainder. Adjusted the rendering logic to allocate the remainder to the largest segment.

tickets.subject: Custom date range filter not updating chart
tickets.description: When the customer selects a custom date range, the chart continues showing the previous default range's data.
tickets.resolution_notes: A caching layer was keying on the filter's display label instead of its actual date values, so custom ranges collided with the cached default. Fixed the cache key to use the resolved date values.

tickets.subject: Dashboard fails to load, spinning indefinitely
tickets.description: The main dashboard shows a loading spinner that never resolves, even after refreshing the page.
tickets.resolution_notes: One widget's data query was timing out and blocking the rest of the dashboard from rendering. Made widget loads independent so a single slow widget no longer blocks the page.

tickets.subject: Invoice shows incorrect seat count
tickets.description: Customer's latest invoice bills for 25 seats but they say they only have 18 active users.
tickets.resolution_notes: Several deactivated user accounts hadn't been removed from the billing seat count due to a sync delay between the user admin panel and the billing system. Issued a prorated credit and fixed the sync delay.

tickets.subject: Unable to update credit card on file
tickets.description: Customer gets a generic error when trying to update their payment method in account settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's new card's billing zip code format (Canadian postal code) wasn't accepted by the payment form's validation. Updated the form to accept international postal code formats.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for the same billing cycle
tickets.description: Customer noticed two identical charges on their card statement for what should be a single monthly charge.
tickets.resolution_notes: A retry mechanism for a previously failed payment double-charged after the original payment actually succeeded on the processor's side. Refunded the duplicate charge and added idempotency keys to the retry logic.

tickets.subject: Downgrade request not reflected in next invoice
tickets.description: Customer requested a plan downgrade last month but was billed at the old, higher rate again.
tickets.resolution_notes: The downgrade was recorded in the CRM but never propagated to the billing system due to a missing webhook subscription. Manually corrected the invoice and added the missing webhook.

tickets.subject: Annual plan discount not applied at checkout
tickets.description: Customer selected the annual billing option expecting a 15% discount, but the checkout total shows the full monthly-equivalent price.
tickets.resolution_notes: The discount code was only auto-applied for new signups, not existing accounts switching billing cycles. Manually applied the discount and fixed the eligibility check.

tickets.subject: CSV export missing last week of data
tickets.description: Customer's CSV export of transaction history is missing the most recent 7 days of records.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export job's date range used the same UTC/local timezone gap as the sync issue in T-1104. Applied the same buffer fix to the export query.

tickets.subject: PDF report export times out for large date ranges
tickets.description: Exporting a PDF report for a full year of data fails with a timeout error after about 30 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: PDF rendering was done synchronously in the request thread. Moved large exports to an async job with an email notification when the file is ready.

tickets.subject: Scheduled weekly report email stopped arriving
tickets.description: Customer used to receive a weekly summary report by email every Monday, but hasn't gotten one in 3 weeks.
tickets.resolution_notes: The scheduled report job silently failed after the customer's dashboard was renamed, since the job referenced the dashboard by its old name instead of its ID. Fixed the job to reference dashboards by ID.

tickets.subject: Exported numbers don't match dashboard totals
tickets.description: The total revenue figure in an exported CSV is noticeably different from what's shown on the live dashboard for the same period.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export used a slightly different filter default (including cancelled orders) than the dashboard view. Aligned both to exclude cancelled orders by default and documented the distinction.

tickets.subject: Export button greyed out for read-only users
tickets.description: A customer with a 'viewer' role reports the export button is disabled and they can't download reports they need for a meeting.
tickets.resolution_notes: This was expected behavior per the permission model, but the customer wasn't aware exports required editor-level access. Clarified the permission model and upgraded the specific user's role at the admin's request.

tickets.subject: New team member can't see any dashboards
tickets.description: A newly invited team member logs in successfully but sees an empty dashboard list with no error message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new user was auto-assigned to a role with no dashboard permissions by default. Assigned them to the correct team role and recommended reviewing the default role for new invites.

tickets.subject: Admin unable to revoke access for former employee
tickets.description: Customer's admin tried to deactivate a former employee's account but the user still appears able to log in.
tickets.resolution_notes: The deactivation only revoked dashboard access but didn't invalidate existing active sessions. Manually terminated the user's active sessions and added session invalidation to the deactivation flow.

tickets.subject: Viewer role can edit dashboards, shouldn't be able to
tickets.description: Customer noticed a user with 'viewer' permissions was able to rearrange and edit widgets on a shared dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: A permission check was missing on the drag-and-drop widget reordering endpoint specifically (other edit actions were correctly restricted). Added the missing permission check.

tickets.subject: Custom role permissions not saving
tickets.description: Customer created a custom role with specific dashboard permissions, but the settings revert after saving.
tickets.resolution_notes: The custom role form silently failed validation when more than 10 dashboards were selected, due to an undocumented limit. Removed the limit and added a clear error message for edge cases.

tickets.subject: SSO user provisioned with wrong default role
tickets.description: New users signing in via SSO are all being given admin access instead of the standard member role.
tickets.resolution_notes: The SSO provisioning configuration had a leftover default-role setting from initial account setup testing. Corrected the default role and audited existing SSO-provisioned users.

tickets.subject: Dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load
tickets.description: Customer with a large account reports their main dashboard consistently takes 30+ seconds to become interactive.
tickets.resolution_notes: A widget was running an unindexed query against a table that had grown significantly for this customer. Added the missing index and introduced query result caching for that widget type.

tickets.subject: Filtering by date range is extremely slow
tickets.description: Applying any custom date filter on the dashboard takes 10-15 seconds to update, compared to under a second previously.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recent schema change removed a covering index used by the date-range filter query. Restored an equivalent index and validated the query plan improved.

tickets.subject: Application becomes unresponsive with large datasets
tickets.description: Customer with over 2 million records reports the entire application becomes sluggish across all pages, not just one dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: A shared metadata query used by the navigation sidebar scanned the full dataset on every page load for this customer's scale. Cached the metadata and refreshed it on a schedule instead of per-request.

tickets.subject: Report generation queue backed up during peak hours
tickets.description: Customer's scheduled reports are arriving hours late during the company's peak usage window each morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: The report generation queue had a single worker shared across all customers, creating contention at peak times. Scaled out to multiple workers with per-customer fairness.

tickets.subject: Search feature times out on large ticket history
tickets.description: Customer with years of historical ticket data reports the in-app search feature times out instead of returning results.
tickets.resolution_notes: The search query performed a full-text scan without an index for accounts with very large historical volumes. Added a full-text search index and a result limit with pagination.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently
tickets.description: Customer's endpoint receives webhook events successfully most of the time but silently misses some events during high-traffic periods.
tickets.resolution_notes: Webhook delivery had no retry logic for transient failures on the customer's endpoint. Added exponential backoff retries and a delivery log the customer can inspect.

tickets.subject: API rate limit reached during normal usage
tickets.description: Customer's integration started receiving 429 rate-limit errors even though their usage pattern hadn't changed recently.
tickets.resolution_notes: A newly added background sync job was making redundant polling calls instead of using the existing webhook events. Recommended switching to webhooks and temporarily raised their rate limit.

tickets.subject: API returns 500 error for valid requests
tickets.description: Customer's integration reports intermittent 500 errors on an endpoint that otherwise works fine most of the time.
tickets.resolution_notes: A specific combination of optional query parameters triggered a null-reference error in an edge case the endpoint hadn't been tested against. Added handling for the missing case and expanded test coverage.

tickets.subject: Webhook payload missing expected fields
tickets.description: Customer says a recently added field they rely on is sometimes missing from the webhook payload they receive.
tickets.resolution_notes: The field was only populated for certain event subtypes but the webhook schema didn't document this distinction clearly. Updated the documentation and added a null-safe default in the payload.

tickets.subject: API key regenerated but old key still works
tickets.description: Customer regenerated their API key for security reasons but noticed the old key still authenticates successfully.
tickets.resolution_notes: Key revocation was queued for asynchronous processing with up to a 15-minute propagation delay that wasn't communicated to the customer. Clarified the expected delay and added a real-time revocation option for security-sensitive cases.
